facts.business: Loyal Textile Mills Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of textiles and garments, with a strategic focus on technical textiles and protective wear (Protech) while reducing exposure to commodity-driven products like yarn.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is confident of executing a successful turnaround in the upcoming fiscal year by focusing on high-margin segments, maintaining operational rigor, and investing in workforce capabilities.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note No. 51 regarding monetization of assets, scaling down of operations, and relocation of manufacturing facilities to improve operational efficiencies and address liquidity constraints; opinion not modified.

key_risks: Shortage of skilled tailors constraining output
Supply chain disruption due to West Asia crisis impacting GCC customer base
Liquidity constraints addressed through asset monetization and operational scaling down
Lower capacity utilization and net loss in FY 2025-26 due to restructuring
Dependence on successful execution of turnaround strategy in high-margin protective textiles
